rationale: No existing spec asserts the ChartSelection component itself: the 20-icon sidebar render, the selected-highlight (data-test-selected/data-selected), the per-icon tooltip, the dark-mode icon variant, or the PromQL-disables-Sankey gating. Existing specs (sankey/html/custom-charts/pie-donut) all *use* pm.chartTypeSelector.selectChartType() to reach other feature areas but never verify the selection sidebar's own rendering/highlight/tooltip/theme behavior. The feature (Add-Panel Chart Selection Icons) is its own area and the run-context designates a fresh spec_path under Dashboards/, so a new spec is correct. Registration required: add the file to the Dashboards-Core shard's run_files in ci_matrix.json.
